entries.title: Avonel Health
entries.description: Avonel Health is a telehealth company for compounded ivermectin. A physician reviews each request, and a 503A-licensed pharmacy compounds and ships what's prescribed. Zealot is building Nell, Avonel's customer support agent. It takes extensive evals and security work to meet HIPAA business associate agreements, zero data retention, and trust center controls near SOC 2 level. https://avonelhealth.com
